title: Autograph Please
desc: A man contracts HIV because of an affair with a bar girl prior to his wedding. However, he decides to live normally and encourages other HIV patients to brave the ordeal.

title: Auto Raja
desc: Raja, an auto-driver, is in awe of the successful actor Shankar Nag. His life changes when he meets Rani, a village girl, who comes to the city to become an actress.

title: Rajadhani
desc: Five friends believe that money can buy anything in the world and wish to get rich quickly. When they choose a crooked way to earn riches, they become entangled in a web of crime.

title: G.O.A.T
desc: After a tragedy tears him apart from his wife, Gandhi, a former elite spy, is forced back into the field for a mission of the utmost importance.

title: Maaman
desc: The uncle struggles to connect with his distant nephew. Despite family tensions, they attempt to bridge the gap through shared experiences.

title: Officer On Duty
desc: A demoted cop looks into fake jewelry criminals, getting caught up in a risky world of bad guys, putting his life in danger as he tries to solve the case.
